decisions.reason: Adding a comment box changes captured form fields but does not change the configured submission recipient emails.
The additional form field does not modify the contact page headline or body copy.
Adding a comment box does not change the available contact action, which remains the contact request.
The early-access CTA still navigates to the contact page containing the form; its destination is unchanged.
The comment-box addition does not change the landing page visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
The source specifies a field within the contact form and does not change the landing page content types, image quantity, or screenshot policy.
